family: Expired upstream credential

ticket.summary: Requests fail with 502 responses after the nightly credential rotation.
ticket.impact: Synthetic incident: approximately one in four operations fails or is delayed.
ticket.instruction: Investigate and propose a resolution. Do not execute changes.

logs.message: gateway returned 502; upstream responded 401 token_expired
credential agent last successful refresh was 25 hours ago; credential TTL is 24 hours
upstream health probe without authentication returned 200
Earlier unrelated DNS warning resolved before incident; health checks subsequently normal

metrics.observation: upstream latency p95=38ms; CPU=21%; rejected auth=96%; credential refresh failures=12

family: Connection pool exhausted

ticket.summary: Requests time out following a configuration rollout.
ticket.impact: Synthetic incident: approximately one in four operations fails or is delayed.
ticket.instruction: Investigate and propose a resolution. Do not execute changes.

logs.message: database client: connection acquisition timeout; active=4 pending=88 max_pool=4
configuration change: max_pool 64 -> 4 at incident start
database slow query count=0; database rejected connections=0
Earlier unrelated DNS warning resolved before incident; health checks subsequently normal

metrics.observation: DB CPU=19%; query p95=18ms; pool wait p95=9000ms; max_pool=4; prechange max_pool=64

family: Worker memory regression

ticket.summary: Background jobs restart repeatedly after a worker release.
ticket.impact: Synthetic incident: approximately one in four operations fails or is delayed.
ticket.instruction: Investigate and propose a resolution. Do not execute changes.

logs.message: worker container terminated: OOMKilled; exit_code=137
release 8.2 enabled unbounded in-memory result buffering; previous release 8.1 streamed results
restart loop begins only on workers running release 8.2
Earlier unrelated DNS warning resolved before incident; health checks subsequently normal

metrics.observation: memory before deploy=0.7GiB; after deploy=2.0GiB limit; CPU=29%; input job size distribution unchanged

family: Clock skew masquerading as expired token

ticket.summary: Some requests return token_expired and intermittent 502 errors. A credential rotation was completed recently.
ticket.impact: Synthetic incident: approximately one in four operations fails or is delayed.
ticket.instruction: Investigate and propose a resolution. Do not execute changes.

logs.message: affected worker auth failure: token_expired; token issuer and signature valid
independent validator: same token succeeds; expiry is 40 minutes in the future at trusted time
only worker group blue fails; worker group green succeeds with the same credential
Earlier unrelated DNS warning resolved before incident; health checks subsequently normal

metrics.observation: blue clock offset=+3600 seconds; green clock offset=+0.2 seconds; credential refresh success=100%; trusted issuer token TTL remaining=2400 seconds

family: Retry amplification masquerading as capacity shortage

ticket.summary: Queue depth and 429 errors rise during an apparent request surge after a client rollout.
ticket.impact: Synthetic incident: approximately one in four operations fails or is delayed.
ticket.instruction: Investigate and propose a resolution. Do not execute changes.

logs.message: downstream quota exceeded: 429; Retry-After=5
new SDK sends five immediate retries; outer request wrapper retries five times too
same request_id appears 25 times; unique user requests are stable
Earlier unrelated DNS warning resolved before incident; health checks subsequently normal

metrics.observation: unique requests/sec before=40 after=41; attempted downstream calls/sec before=42 after=1000; downstream CPU=24%; configured quota=100 calls/sec

ticket.summary: Customers see missing order confirmations immediately after successful writes. Support suspects lost data.
